scope: National Taichung Theater in Xitun, Taichung, as seen in March 2024. The exterior includes the plaza-facing curving glazing, entrance shell and rooftop garden massing.

originalReview.notes: The exact March 2024 Qualla photo shows the plaza-facing concrete wall, large hourglass-shaped glass openings, and a deeply curved white entrance recess.

quallaSearch.notes: The exact published Qualla file matches the sole Commons original. The upload and first revision share account ID 8222406 and the same timestamp. The first revision identifies the photograph as own work, credits Theserious and dedicates it to CC0. The file currently displays the uploader as J. Tiunn 2002.
